{"command": "python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0062.png"))
# Cabinet is right in the center!
mask_cab = (img[:, :, 0] > 180) & (img[:, :, 1] > 180) & (img[:, :, 2] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 350)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_cab)
print(f"Cabinet top/front in 62: xs=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], ys=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], bottom={ys.max()}, cx={xs.mean():.1f}")
'", "description": "Locate cabinet in obs_0062"}
